context:
Goal: q_max browser runs are cheap enough to prove fixes.
Problem (rule): q_max main's browser suite has been red on every run since Nov 4 (about 20 failures; run 42299820546). The merge tool refuses every q_max merge without your typed --base-red-ok. Lane qmax-browser-main-red has started on the red.
Based on (measured): #1040's split run takes 21 min 35 s, against 1 h 43 min on main.
Departs from: main runs browser checks as one 1 h 43 min job — #1040 lands first, so the fix lane's proof runs take about 22 min.
If a: after #1040's review round 2 passes and item 321 is answered, type --base-red-ok once in batch runner 9's chat, for #1040 only.
Meanwhile: runner 9 holds all q_max merges.

options.gain: Every fix proof run is about 5 times faster.
options.label: Merge #1040 onto red main, once
options.lose: One merge onto red main. The red is old, and #1040 does not cause it.

options.label: Wait for main to go green first
options.lose: The fix lane proves on 1 h 43 min runs.

title: Merge q_max #1040 (faster browser checks) before main's old red is fixed?
